# Project Hub

Read the repository-root `AGENTS.md` for routing instructions and `PROJECTS.md` for the project directory. Resolve those paths from the repository root, not from this `.github` directory.

Use the same project directory as human readers and other agents. Each project's registered `.code-workspace` file defines its member directories. Do not assume a routed project is already open; ask the user to open that workspace when needed. Respect each member folder's local instructions and repository boundaries.
